event: "Let's do the ring. I like to keep my hands free," Nala says.
"Anything we can do to make it stronger? I've gold to spare, up to fifty. What options do you have?"
Ilse settles her spectacles. "Plain ring, I'll have it set by the afternoon of day ten."
"The honest part first: a focus buys reach, or holds mana. The force is all yours to bring."
"Reach counts for held workings. Loosed beams, slugs and bullets fly as far as they ever did."
She lifts a second pearl from a case. "Mine. Beside yours, two pearls reach seventy yards."
"Seven gold, setting included, and a day more on the ring."
A tray holds a dull grey stone. "A well-stone. Twenty gold, three days more. Holds forty mana."
"Fill it from your own, ten a minute, easy. Draw on it, and the forty is back in half a minute."
"Half up front covers the extras too; the rest when I hand the ring over."
"Band metal's all one to a focus. And I set at my own pace, whatever you pay."
Ilse folds her inky hands on the counter. "So. Plain, second pearl, well-stone, or both?"
